character: He wears a thin ancient Greek outfit: a knee-length off-white linen chiton tunic with a narrow blue-and-gold meander border at the hem, pinned on both shoulders with small bronze clasps, a thin brown leather belt at the waist, bare arms with simple brown leather wrist bracers, brown leather sandals with straps wrapped up to mid-calf. Short dark curly hair, clean-shaven young face with a calm expression, slim athletic build.
